items.title: Renaissance Technologies Grew Its SanDisk Stake More Than 55-Fold to $481 Million
items.summary: A quant fund that never explains its trades just bet big on memory chips, right before the stock cratered. Before copying a filing that is weeks old, see what a 13F hides and which signals matter more.

items.title: Stanley Druckenmiller and 11 Other Big Funds Bought Western Digital Last Quarter. Ken Fisher and 13 Others Sold. Who’s Right?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysOf 460 big funds that have filed 13Fs for the quarter ended Sept. 30, 12 bought Western Digital, Stanley Druckenmiller’s Duquesne Family Office among them, and 14 sold, Ken Fisher’s Fisher Investments among them.

items.title: Western Digital (WDC) Secures A US$1.5b Credit Facility, Is The Pullback A Buying Opportunity?
items.summary: Western Digital (WDC) just locked in a new five-year, US$1.5 billion senior unsecured revolving credit facility, replacing its prior loan agreement and paying off all amounts outstanding under that structure. The revolving facility lands as Western Digital’s share price has come under pressure, falling about 26% over the past month and roughly 43% over 90 days. This comes even though the year-to-date share price return is 39% and the 1-year total shareholder return is 87.94%, with a very...

items.title: Credo Technology Group vs. Western Digital: Which Technology Stock Is a Better Buy for 2027?
items.summary: Credo's AI connectivity and Western Digital's storage rebound are very different bets, and the valuation gap between them may tip the scales.

items.title: Navitas Sinks 15%, Western Down 12%, Everpure Down 13% as AI Chip Rout Deepens
items.summary: Key TakeawaysNavitas Semiconductor fell 15% today with no news of its own, as an AI chip sell-off that started in Asia deepened in New York. Western Digital, Everpure and D-Wave Quantum fell too, as Anthropic slid on its second trading day and California’s attorney general subpoenaed Nvidia.

items.title: Micron Is Down 32% in a Month. Can MU Stock Get Back to $1,000?
items.summary: A 12% single-day plunge has wiped out billions in Micron's value just as UBS questions whether AI spending can ever pay for itself. The memory giant's bulls have committed shipments on their side, but one upcoming test could decide everything.

items.title: Western Digital Stock Falls 12% in the Memory Chip Selloff. It Spun Off Its Flash Business Last Year and Now Sits 65% Below Its Record
items.summary: Western Digital (WDC) fell 12% to about $261 on Friday as the AI chip selloff hit memory and storage stocks for a second day. The hard drive maker spun off its flash business in 2025, is 65% below its June record and trades at about 20 times trailing adjusted earnings.

items.title: Western Digital Cratered 40% in The Last 3 Months: This Wall Street Desk Now Predicts 200% Returns After Raising Its Target Price
items.summary: Western Digital keeps posting record results and analysts keep raising estimates, yet the stock keeps sliding. One Wall Street desk sees a rebound far bigger than the rest, and the reason may lie in a corner of the AI buildout most investors ignore.
